settings.label: Realistic flight
settings.info: Off: arcade (the disc tilts with the stick and springs back, it never tips over). On: a rigid body with the rotor's thrust along its own up axis: it loops, rolls and flies upside down, where the thrust pushes it down. Switches in flight too.

settings.label: Assist (realistic)
settings.info: Levels the helicopter while the cyclic stick is centred and damps its turning. 0: none, it keeps whatever attitude it has. Full stick still loops.

settings.label: Stick sensitivity (realistic)
settings.info: How hard the cyclic and the pedals turn it.

settings.label: Rotor speed (picture)
settings.info: 100 %: as in the game's own drop scenes (the main rotor 1000 degrees a second).
